caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a sculpted figure of a dog, rendered in brown tones. The dog stands on all four legs atop a rectangular base with rounded edges, also colored brown with small circular details on the surface and text inscribed in the center. The body of the dog is detailed to show musculature with darker lines indicating the separation of the legs, the snout, ear, and jawline. The tail of the dog is exaggeratedly large and curves upward in an arc. The figure has two visible circular screws or fasteners on its body, one on the head and one on the torso. The background is plain and uncolored, highlighting the brown dog sculpture as the only subject in the composition.
title: Nutcracker - Dog
